title: Authentication errors do not follow the documented error shape
actual: 401 responses are { error: 'Authentication required' } with no code or request_id, while 404s include both.
impact: Clients cannot branch on a stable code (e.g. TOKEN_EXPIRED vs REVOKED) and support cannot trace 401s by request_id.
fix: Use apiError helpers in middleware/auth.ts with distinct codes (UNAUTHORIZED, TOKEN_EXPIRED, TOKEN_REVOKED); keep the error text. Update frontend checks that compare message strings.
